paper_title: DeltaEdit Enhancing Sequential Editing in Large Language Models by   Controlling Superimposed Noise
caption: The changes in Efficacytop (the rate of successfully maximizing the object's probability) and noise_E with the number of edits. The top figure displays results for GPT2-XL using AlphaEdit and MEMIT, while the bottom figure shows results for LLaMA3-8B using only AlphaEdit. MEMIT is excluded for LLaMA3-8B due to its excessively high noise_E, making visualization difficult.

model_annotations.English: This plot illustrates the changes in Efficacy$_{top}$ and noise$_E$ with the number of edits for GPT2-XL using AlphaEdit and MEMIT. The x-axis represents the number of edits, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 3000, with tick labels at intervals of 500. The left y-axis represents Efficacy$_{top}$, with a linear scale, ranging from 30 to 100, and tick labels at intervals of 10, while the right y-axis represents noise$_E$, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 140, and tick labels at intervals of 20. The plot displays four lines: AlphaEdit Efficacy$_{top}$ (red, dashed) starts at 100 and decreases to 87 at 3000 edits; MEMIT Efficacy$_{top}$ (blue, dashed) starts at 88 and decreases to 8 at 3000 edits; AlphaEdit noise$_E$ (red, solid) starts at 27.5 and increases to 30 at 3000 edits; MEMIT noise$_E$ (blue, solid) starts at 29 and increases to 145 at 3000 edits, with notable increases at 1500 edits (45) and 2500 edits (115).
model_annotations.German: This plot illustrates the changes in Efficacy$_{top}$ and noise$_E$ with the number of edits for GPT2-XL using AlphaEdit and MEMIT. The x-axis represents the number of edits, labeled without units, ranging from 0 to 3000 on a linear scale with tick labels at intervals of 500. The left y-axis represents Efficacy$_{top}$, ranging from 30 to 100 on a linear scale with tick labels at intervals of 10, while the right y-axis represents noise$_E$, ranging from 0 to 140 on a linear scale with tick labels at intervals of 20. Four lines are shown: AlphaEdit Efficacy$_{top}$ (red, dashed line) starts at 99.5 at 250 edits and decreases to 86 at 3000 edits; MEMIT Efficacy$_{top}$ (blue, dashed line) starts at 88 at 250 edits and decreases to 5 at 3000 edits; AlphaEdit noise$_E$ (red, solid line) starts at 28 at 250 edits and increases to 30 at 3000 edits; MEMIT noise$_E$ (blue, solid line) starts at 30 at 250 edits, increases steadily to 145 at 3000 edits, with a notable increase between 2000 and 3000 edits.
